request.subject: PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: a single item sprite shown whole and centred on a transparent background, a slight three-quarter angle looking a little down, filling most of the square with a small margin, nothing cropped.

Faction: retro 1950s pulp science-fiction invaders, cheerful and toy-like. Their fixed colours: polished chrome and silver-white metal shaded with soft blue-grey, dark gunmetal joints and undersides, rivets and small fins, clear pale glass domes with one white highlight, and exactly one accent colour, a bright glowing hot magenta pink, only as small lights and glows: lamps, lenses, antenna tips, emitter tips.
layers.negative: green skin, green alien, lime, slime, tentacles, blue glow, cyan glow, yellow lights, orange flames, fire, red, gold, brass, brown, wood, leather, rust, purple, violet, medieval, sword, bow, horse, scary, horror, realistic, large glowing area

layers.text: Class: one bold chunky item sprite with a single clear subject and a big simple silhouette, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat colours with one shadow tone, very few details; it must read at a glance at 48 pixels. The item floats alone on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn behind or under it.
layers.negative: icon frame, round badge, medallion, emblem, coin-shaped backdrop, button, border, circular background, square background, vignette, background scenery, ground tile, grass square, pedestal, many small objects, text, letters, numbers

layers.text: Subject: Tripod, the head of a three-legged walking war machine shown large: a rounded hooded polished chrome head like a smooth cowl with rivets, one big round glowing hot magenta eye lens in front, the tops of three thin dark gunmetal legs below it and a small heat-ray emitter arm with a glowing hot magenta tip; simple shapes and very few details.

The head is one smooth round silver-white chrome hood with no cap and no window; the legs are dark gunmetal with round chrome joints. The metal is plain polished silver-white chrome shaded soft blue-grey, never blue, teal or pink; hot magenta appears only as the small lights and lenses.
layers.negative: person, horn, spike, brass, gold, orange, blue metal, cyan, teal, turquoise, glass, gun barrel on top
